sql.if: AND (a_def.API_NO IN ( SELECT sub_def.API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_STATUS_INFO sub_as_if INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF sub_def ON (sub_def.API_NO = sub_as_if.API_NO) AND (sub_as_if.CHECK_YN = 'Y') AND (sub_as_if.USE_YN = 'Y') INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_STATUS_SPC_GROUP_LINK as_grplnk ON (as_grplnk.API_SPC_NO = sub_def.API_SPC_NO) WHERE (as_grplnk.STATUS_GROUP_NO = #{statusGroupNo}) ))

mapper.select: /* apistatus.select_API_STATUS_SPC_GROUP_LIST */ SELECT as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NM , as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO , as_grp.SORT_ODRG , as_sgulnk.SEQ AS user_link_SEQ , as_sgulnk.SORT_ODRG AS user_link_SORT_ODRG FROM LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_STATUS_SPC_GROUP_USER_LINK as_sgulnk ON (as_sgulnk.STATUS_GROUP_NO = as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO) AND (as_sgulnk.USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY COALESCE(as_sgulnk.SORT_ODRG, 999), COALESCE(as_grp.SORT_ODRG, 999), as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NM, as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO

/* apistatus.select_GROUP_SUMMARY_INFO */ SELECT as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NM , as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO , ( AND (sub_as_if.STATUS_CODE = 'OK')) AS as_ok_count , ( AND (sub_as_if.STATUS_CODE = 'DL')) AS as_dl_count , ( AND (sub_as_if.STATUS_CODE = 'NK')) AS as_nk_count FROM
AND (as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO = #{statusGroupNo})

/* apistatus.select_GROUP_API_STATUS_LIST */ SELECT a_sys.SYS_ID , a_sys.SYS_NM , a_spc.API_SPC_NO , a_spc.API_NM AS as_API_SPC_NM , a_def.API_NO , a_def.API_NM , TO_CHAR(as_if.STATUS_CHECK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS STATUS_CHECK_DT , as_if.STATUS_CODE , as_if.STATUS_RES_MSEC FROM
INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_STATUS_SPC_GROUP_LINK as_grplnk ON (as_grplnk.API_SPC_NO = a_def.API_SPC_NO) INNER JOIN ON (as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO = as_grplnk.STATUS_GROUP_NO) WHERE (as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO = #{statusGroupNo}) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN (as_if.STATUS_CODE = 'OK') THEN 3 WHEN (as_if.STATUS_CODE = 'NK') THEN 1 WHEN (as_if.STATUS_CODE = 'DL') THEN 2 ELSE 4 END) , as_if.STATUS_CHECK_DT DESC , a_def.API_NO DESC

/* apistatus.select_API_STATUS_INFO_LIST */
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a_sys.SORT_ODRG, a_sys.SUB_SORT_ODRG, a_sys.SYS_NM, a_spc.API_NM, a_spc.API_SPC_ID, a_spc.API_SPC_NO, a_def.API_NM, a_def.API_NO) rownum , a_sys.SYS_ID , a_sys.SYS_NM , a_spc.API_SPC_NO , a_spc.API_NM AS as_API_SPC_NM , a_def.API_NO , a_def.API_NM , TO_CHAR(as_if.STATUS_CHECK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS STATUS_CHECK_DT , as_if.STATUS_CODE , as_if.STATUS_RES_MSEC FROM

/* apistatus.select_API_STATUS_INFO_LIST_STATUS_CODE_COUNT */ SELECT as_if.STATUS_CODE, COUNT(*) AS count FROM
GROUP BY as_if.STATUS_CODE

/* apistatus.select_API_STATUS_CHECK_HIST_DAILY_LIST */
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a_sys.SORT_ODRG, a_sys.SUB_SORT_ODRG, a_sys.SYS_NM, a_spc.API_NM, a_spc.API_SPC_ID, a_spc.API_SPC_NO, a_def.API_NM, a_def.API_NO) rownum , a_sys.SYS_ID , a_sys.SYS_NM , a_spc.API_SPC_NO , a_spc.API_NM AS as_API_SPC_NM , a_def.API_NO , a_def.API_NM , TO_CHAR(as_if.STATUS_CHECK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS STATUS_CHECK_DT , as_if.STATUS_CODE , as_if.STATUS_RES_MSEC , ( SELECT STRING_AGG( TO_CHAR(as_cdh.STATUS_CHECK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || '::' || as_cdh.STATUS_CODE || '::' || CAST(as_cdh.STATUS_RES_MSEC AS VARCHAR), ';' ORDER BY as_cdh.STATUS_CHECK_YMD ) FROM KOA_TB_API_STATUS_CHECK_DAILY_HST as_cdh WHERE (as_cdh.API_NO = as_if.API_NO) AND (as_cdh.STATUS_CHECK_YMD BETWEEN #{startStatusCheckYmd} AND #{endStatusCheckYmd}) ) daily_list FROM

/* apistatus.select_API_STATUS_CHECK_HIST */ SELECT as_chst.SEQ , a_sys.SYS_ID , a_sys.SYS_NM , a_spc.API_SPC_NO , a_spc.API_NM AS as_API_SPC_NM , a_def.API_NO , a_def.API_NM , TO_CHAR(as_chst.STATUS_CHECK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS STATUS_CHECK_DT , as_chst.STATUS_CODE , as_chst.STATUS_RES_MSEC , TO_CHAR(as_chst.ST_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ST_TIME , TO_CHAR(as_chst.END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS END_TIME , as_chst.PROC_RESULT_CD , as_chst.PROC_RESULT_MSG , as_chst.REQ_API_URL , as_chst.REQ_HEADERS , as_chst.REQ_BODY , as_chst.REQ_TRANSACTION_ID , as_chst.REQ_SEQUENCE_NO , as_chst.RES_TRANSACTION_ID , as_chst.RES_SEQUENCE_NO , as_chst.RES_RETURN_CODE , as_chst.RES_RETURN_DESCRIPTION , as_chst.RES_ERROR_CODE , as_chst.RES_ERROR_DESCRIPTION , as_chst.RES_RESPONSE FROM KOA_TB_API_STATUS_CHECK_HST as_chst INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF a_def ON (a_def.API_NO = as_chst.API_NO) INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC a_spc ON (a_spc.API_SPC_NO = a_def.API_SPC_NO) INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM a_sys ON (a_sys.SYS_ID = a_spc.SYS_ID) WHERE (as_chst.SEQ = #{seq})

/* apistatus.insert_API_STATUS_SPC_GROUP_USER_LINK */ INSERT INTO KOA_TB_API_STATUS_SPC_GROUP_USER_LINK ( USER_ID, STATUS_GROUP_NO , SORT_ODRG ) VALUES
( #{userId}, #{item.statusGroupNo}, #{item.sortOdrg} )
mapper.select: /* apistatus.select_dum_API_STATUS_SPC_GROUP_LIST */ SELECT as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NO , as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NM FROM ORDER BY COALESCE(as_grp.SORT_ODRG, 999), as_grp.STATUS_GROUP_NM
